title: Warm Light Brazilian Cheese Pilao
description: A light, indulgent, and romantic Brazilian dish perfect for a date night. It features a warm and creamy sauce made with liquid cheese.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of coconut oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the chopped onion and sauté for another minute until softened.
Add the green chilies, tadka spice blend, salt, and white pepper. Sauté for 1 minute.
Pour in the liquid cheese and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While the cheese sauce is cooking, steam the cauliflower florets in a separate saucepan until tender.
Once the cheese sauce has thickened, add it to the steamed cauliflower and stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the Warm Light Brazilian Cheese Pilao to individual plates or a large serving dish.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
